findings.detail: issuer_name includes schedule hierarchy and instrument terms instead of just the Portfolio Company value; for the cited row the correct issuer is 1440 Foods Topco, LLC.

rationale: The raw source schedule has separate columns for Portfolio Company, Instrument, Industry, Rate, Interest Rate, acquisition date, and maturity date. In table 10 row 5 the Portfolio Company cell is only 1440 Foods Topco, LLC, while the extracted issuer_name shown in the review bundle concatenates the hierarchy, country, company, instrument, industry, rate, interest rate, acquisition date, and maturity date. That is a real issuer-name extraction/column mapping defect, not a formatting false alarm.
